annotation_provenance.scope: All 180 native frames inspected through 30 enlarged raw temporal sheets; visible points checked in enlarged local crops before evaluating this packet. Coordinates are approximate, sometimes refined with local bright components. No interpolation or evaluated predictions supplied labels. Sparse model previews had been seen previously; not blind or held-out review.

limitations: Selected, correlated development examples; not held-out data or full-video precision/recall.
Negative regions label only local distractors, not absence of a shuttle elsewhere in the frame.
Evaluation never promotes proposals to verified trajectories or enables events/scoring.
Uncertain annotations break continuity statistics and never imply shuttle absence; point matches do not certify object identity or physical trajectories.
